title: fix(cloud-connection): a catalog list query the public snapshot cannot evaluate takes the cloud path
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XgDazcrZck9D43vqCZy4A1)_

Fixes #31834

Clause-②: no. Measured: on base `cfe35630` and on head, the door accepts the same query keys (nothing new is refused, nothing new is read on the forwarding path); only which path answers a list query carrying a key the snapshot does not evaluate moves, from the snapshot to the cloud. RED on base / green on head below.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：设置了 `OS_MARKETPLACE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 的运行时，应用市场目录列表请求里只要带了快照读不懂的查询参数（如云端新加的 `languages`，或任何其它键），就不再由快照自己过滤，而是原样转发给云端，答案与没配快照时逐字节相同（含云端的 facet 计数）。
- 为什么改：之前快照路径把读不懂的键静默丢掉：按语言筛选返回未过滤的全部目录（200），带分页时还丢了计数，调用方无从分辨。
- 风险与回滚：只影响带了未知键的列表请求，这类请求失去「云端休眠时走快照」的捷径；云端不可达时答已有的 `502 MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED`，不再静默 200。只带已认识键（q、limit、offset、maturity、三个 taxonomy facet）的请求仍走快照。回滚即 revert，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-proxy-plugin.ts` 的 `SNAPSHOT_EVALUATED_LIST_PARAMS` 与 `tryPublicMarketplaceFetch` 开头新加的一行；测试文件末尾新 describe。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/marketplace-proxy-browse-only.test.ts`，预期 21 passed；新 describe 的前三条在 main 上是红的。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **The snapshot answers a catalog list request only when it evaluates every key the request carries.** `SNAPSHOT_EVALUATED_LIST_PARAMS` is the closed set the snapshot reader evaluates: `q`, `limit`, `offset`, `maturity` and the three taxonomy facets (built from `CATALOG_FACETS`, so a facet added to the reader joins it). A list request carrying any other key makes `tryPublicMarketplaceFetch` return `null` before the snapshot is fetched, and the request takes the existing forwarding path: `${cloudUrl}${pathname}${search}`, query string verbatim, the same answer as a runtime with the variable unset.
2. **`languages` is the first such key, not a special case** (seat ruling, option c widened): the next facet the cloud adds cannot be silently ignored on this path either.
3. **Facet counts come from the cloud.** A `languages` read is now answered by the cloud's own list response, so whatever counts it serves reach the caller unchanged. No follow-up is needed for the count half of the card, and no count shape is assumed here (#31462 has not answered it).
4. **Unchanged:** the shared reader `readCatalogListQuery` (still runs before both paths, same refusals), the forwarding path, the detail and manifest snapshot paths, and the snapshot's answers to queries made only of evaluated keys. No new public name, error code or export.

## Tests

`marketplace-proxy-browse-only.test.ts` (the proxy's shared harness), new top-level describe "a key the public snapshot does not evaluate takes the cloud path", 5 cases. The cloud stub answers a body carrying an extra `facets` key, so a re-serialized snapshot page would visibly drop it.

- `?languages=zh-CN` alone: forwarded verbatim, body equals the cloud body (main: the whole `packages.json` streamed verbatim).
- `?languages=zh-CN,ja-JP&businessFunctions=sales&limit=20&offset=0`: forwarded verbatim, body equals the cloud body (main: a snapshot page filtered by the other facet, counts dropped).
- A made-up key (`?limit=20&offset=0&licenses=mit`): forwarded verbatim.
- CONTROL: a query of every evaluated key is answered from the snapshot (`x-cache: PUBLIC-R2-FILTERED`, one row, no cloud call); a bare request streams the snapshot (`x-cache: PUBLIC-R2`).
- CONTROL: with no snapshot configured, the same `languages` query is forwarded verbatim.

Forced test changes: none. The harness header gains two lines naming the rule.

## Acceptance notes

- Guardrail checked before coding (seat ruling): the only catalog-list caller in the workspace is the console's `listMarketplacePackages` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts`), which sends only `q`, the three facets, `maturity`, `limit` and `offset`, all evaluated. No SDK or CLI caller reads the list. So no always-present key turns the snapshot off.
- Whether cloud's snapshot writer carries `latest_version.supported_locales` was not measured (cloud repo outside this session; staging unreachable). This fix does not depend on it.
- `marketplace-public-url.ts`'s comment block (non-trivial filters route via cloud; filtering callers fetch the whole snapshot) still states the rule correctly, so it is not touched.

## Verification

Head tests, base `cfe35630` plugin source (`git restore --source=cfe35630`), under the verify lock: 3 failed / 18 passed, the three forwarding pins. Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Head: Test Files 1 passed, Tests 21 passed.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the new early return deleted</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on the line `if (key === 'packages.json' && carriesSnapshotUnevaluatedListParam(…)) return null;`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `9be75e16` to `b01837c6`. Result: 3 failed / 18 passed, the same three pins; both CONTROLs green. Restored by the tool: blob equals HEAD `9be75e16`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import the plugin from `src` by a relative path, so no rebuild or dist leg applies.
</details>
